title: AI Helped Find Critical PHP Flaws. Websites Went Offline to Patch
description:
Two critical flaws in PHP, the code behind about 70% of websites with a known server language, were found with help from AI: Calif used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, and Wiz independently found both.
The NSA said patch now or take sites offline; PHP shipped fixes on October 21 and sites around the world went dark while they updated.
